name: How should I prepare my home before bathroom floor tile installation?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my home before bathroom floor tile installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before installation begins, clear all personal belongings, rugs, toiletries, and freestanding storage out of the bathroom. If you plan to keep your existing vanity and baseboards, decide whether they should be pulled and reinstalled over the new tile or if the tile will butt against them. Homeowners should also measure doorway transitions, as adding backer board and thick tile can raise floor height and require trimming the door bottom. Additionally, ensure the contractor has a clear pathway to bring in tools and wet saws.
acceptedAnswer.description: Remove all personal items, clear a path for tools, and decide whether existing vanities, trim, and doors need adjustment to accommodate the new floor height.
